title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
abstract: arXiv:2607.15065v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Predictive world models enable robots to simulate the visual outcomes of their actions, but state-of-the-art diffusion-based models remain costly because generating each rollout requires multi-step iterative denoising. We introduce DriftWorld, an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models. DriftWorld learns a conditional drift during training, enabling it to generate future observations for a given action sequence in a single forward pass during inference. Across Bridge-V2, RT-1, Language Table, Push-T, and Robomimic, DriftWorld runs at over 40 fps and is 12+ times faster than diffusion-based baselines, while matching or improving their visual generation quality. This makes DriftWorld an efficient world model for robot simulation and further enables downstream applications including inference-time action search and offline policy evaluation.

translated_title: DriftWorld：通过漂移实现快速世界建模
translated_abstract: 预测性世界模型使机器人能够模拟其动作产生的视觉结果，但最先进的基于扩散的模型成本高昂，因为每次生成轨迹都需要多步迭代去噪。我们提出了DriftWorld，这是一种基于漂移生成模型的动作条件世界模型。DriftWorld在训练过程中学习条件漂移，使其在推理时能够通过单次前向传播为给定动作序列生成未来观测。在Bridge-V2、RT-1、Language Table、Push-T和Robomimic基准上，DriftWorld运行速度超过40 fps，比基于扩散的基线快12倍以上，同时达到或超越其视觉生成质量。这使得DriftWorld成为机器人仿真中的高效世界模型，并进一步支持推理时动作搜索和离线策略评估等下游应用。
tldr: DriftWorld基于漂移生成模型学习条件漂移，实现单次前向传播即可生成未来观测的动作条件世界模型，速度超过40 fps、比扩散基线快12倍以上且视觉质量相当或更优。
en_tdlr: DriftWorld is an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models that learns a conditional drift to generate future observations in a single forward pass, running at over 40 fps—more than 12x faster than diffusion-based baselines—while matching or improving visual quality.
